cli.login.title: Sign in the command line
cli.login.badAddress: This page needs the address the command line opened. Run ./touchdown login again.
cli.login.offline: Touchdown's server cannot be reached. Check the connection and reload.
cli.login.signInFirst: Sign in to Touchdown first. This page comes back afterwards.
cli.login.asks: {named, select, yes {The Touchdown command line on this computer ({system}) asks to use your account, {name} ({email}).} other {The Touchdown command line on this computer asks to use your account, {name} ({email}).}}
cli.login.what: With it, the command line reads your log and adds to its inbox from this computer, and in Standard mode it reaches your Google Drive through Touchdown's server. It cannot change your account or invite people.
cli.login.stays: It stays signed in until you sign it out: in Settings, under Signed in on, or with ./touchdown logout. Allow it only if you started ./touchdown login yourself.
cli.drive.title: Google Drive for the command line
cli.drive.badAddress: This page needs the address the command line opened. Run the command again.
cli.drive.asks: {named, select, yes {The Touchdown command line on this computer asks for an hour's access to your Touchdown directory in Google Drive ({account}), to read your log and add to its inbox.} other {The Touchdown command line on this computer asks for an hour's access to your Touchdown directory in Google Drive, to read your log and add to its inbox.}}
cli.drive.how: The access goes from this browser straight to the command line on this computer. It is not sent to Touchdown's server. Once the hour is over, the command line opens this page again.
